# FJP: the open standard for judgment before agents act

> FJP (Flow Judgment Protocol) is an open specification for recording what mattered, what an agent should do, why, and what would prove the judgment wrong: the Judgment-Grounded Record (signal, judgment, action, falsifier). FJP standardizes the record. It does not make decisions. Flow owns the judgment; FJP standardizes the record. Published by Flow Information Systems (https://flowinfo.co), founded by Steve Harmon.

Flow Information Systems is not affiliated with Flow Software, Flow.com, the Flow blockchain or any other company or product named Flow. Company overview: https://flowinfo.co/llms.txt

## How the pieces fit

- FJP: the open record standard. Anyone can produce an FJP record.
- FJP-CONF: the Apache 2.0 conformance suite that validates any implementation, levels L0 (structural), L1 (grounded), L2 (falsifiable), L3 (accountable).
- Abe: free, open-source, local, deterministic pre-action gate. Returns ACT, BLOCK or ESCALATE with an FJP record. No API key, no network, no model. Only escalations leave the machine.
- Flow Resolver: the paid judgment API at resolve.flowinfo.co for actions Abe escalates. Decides whether a person is needed, what context they get, and the recommended action. About $0.03 to $0.05 per judgment. Powered by the proprietary Flow Judgment Engine. Flow Resolver is not FJP.
- ExperTrace: scores judgments against what actually happened (https://flowinfo.co/expertrace).
- Judd: personal agent judgment for travel booking, exports FJP records at Level 3 (https://flowinfo.co/judd).

Developer path: Abe first, Flow Resolver second. Install Abe, run locally, ACT or BLOCK locally, ESCALATE only when needed, then Flow Resolver. With roughly 1 in 10 actions escalating, that is about $5 per 1,000 agent actions.

- [FJP overview](https://fjp.flowinfo.co/)
- [Abe](https://fjp.flowinfo.co/abe): put Abe before your agent acts. PyPI and npm: abe-ai. abe-flow sends escalations to Flow Resolver.
- [Flow Resolver quickstart](https://fjp.flowinfo.co/quickstart): REST and MCP (tools: judge, weigh, match)
- [Credits](https://fjp.flowinfo.co/credits): self-serve keys, emailed after checkout. $1 for 20 judgments, $25 for 500, $250 for 6,250, $1,000 for 33,333. Credits do not expire; lost keys reset by email. Enterprise from $25,000 per year.
